verified: All 14 scenario roots render at 320px with no horizontal overflow; normal width also checked at 736px.
Persona cycles, hides and shows the same frozen card; ending Present preserves independent Persona.
Single candidate omits cycling; empty preparation leads to a prepared sample collection and live copy.
Prepared-set replace/hide affects only selected copy; saved layout survives cycling to another set and back.
Failed retry retains audio; hiding message retains retry; Record again preserves earlier audio after cancelling the new recording.
Successful retry with blocked insertion exposes Copy and completed History review.
Copy now during Draw does not cause insertion when Draw ends.
Read pause survives Draw ending; failed playback keeps text and retries through preparation.
Snap cancel saves nothing; unsaved capture remains reachable after leaving; Save creates a reviewable sample record.
Snap & Talk cancellation preserves earlier captures; saved session can be reviewed.
Device reconnect remains disconnected until sample availability changes; preparing another scene does not change the live presentation.
Still scene removes device and motion controls; Full screen/Window changes the rendered preview.
Meeting and Timer transports are independent; finishing Present preserves an active Timer.
Hidden toolbar restores through Workbench menu; collapsed mark contains no SVG/icon; Keep open disables collapse.
Keyboard arrows, typeahead, Enter and Escape operate chooser without starting selected work.
Drawing pointer input creates a mark and Undo removes it.
Exported #recovery-pending loads that scenario; changing scenarios updates the exported URL.
No JavaScript console errors in browser checks; extracted script passes syntax check.
Hidden toolbar preference retains active playback controls; dismissing reading failure retains text and voice, returning to Listen.
Copying Earlier dictation from History during Meeting + Timer preserves the sample recording signal and Stop transcribing meeting control; Meetings opens the active owner.

Native-alignment follow-up: 58 focused headless browser checks pass, including waiting dictation retaining Stop drawing primary, Copy preserving Draw and not inserting on Draw end, Read dismissal returning to Listen with retained text, all 14 scenario IDs/deep links/resets, 320/736/1024px widths and zero page errors. Extracted script syntax passes.
limits: The original browser study changed no native app source, installer or live data. The subsequent native implementation is recorded separately in nativeImplementation; this canvas remains a simulation.
Sample devices, transcripts, capture previews, clipboard, saved records and external handoffs are local simulation only.
Browser drag automation did not produce a stroke; direct pointer input and Undo were verified. Native drawing, drag/docking and hit geometry still need installed acceptance.
Native microphone/Accessibility permissions, physical device capture, multi-display full screen, global shortcuts, native external-app launch and real paste delivery are not validated by this canvas.
The original proposed desktop live-copy, live-presentation and Keep open relocations are now implemented in native source and registry/contract updates; combined installed acceptance remains pending.
The full native annotation menu and platform-specific capture permissions are retained in their owners; this study models representative drawing and capture journeys, not every native setting.

The native Copy-during-active-meeting, stationary-pointer and VoiceOver-hold fixes belong to PR #230 at 62f8ba5 with evidence commit 45276a6. Canvas checks do not substitute for its installed keyboard/VoiceOver acceptance.

nativeClarifications: Dismiss Read failure retains text and voice; Listen renders again. Retry is offered only while the failure exists.
Copy now is directly available under Dictate in the chooser; the primary retains Stop drawing while Draw owns input.
Timer and Meetings have conditional activity rows, not additional toolbar modes.
